songs.title: The Years (Prolouge)
songs.lyrics:
Shy kid, knees always bruised
The daddy's girl that became you|In the front seat, you pulled me close
Kissed my lips, it tasted like home|Flashes of crosswords and chamomile
The years pass like a Ferris Wheel|The tiny fractures in the form
The days we live are so much more|We got a little place near the beach
We watch the sailboats out at sea
And we ride along the Palisades|Love is just a summer day
If you hold too tight it starts to fade|Let it go then, then it floats away
In time will you remember me|For a second we had everything
Half awake and sunburned…|Searching vines of summer…
Aimless and upwards…
